title: Superintelligence
description: A mind that improves itself. Computronium becomes possible.

puzzle.goal: A mind improves itself at a rate that grows faster than its current capability: dI/dt = k·I^(1+ε) with ε > 0. Separate the variables and write the moment t_s at which I becomes infinite, starting from capability I0 at time t0.
puzzle.name: Finite-time blow-up of super-linear self-improvement (hyperbolic growth)
puzzle.ask: The integral equals 1/(k ε I0^ε). Find the blow-up time for the values given.

vars.\u03b5: excess of the growth exponent over 1

puzzle.method: Divide both sides by k·I^(1+ε) and integrate dt on one side and dI on the other; the I-integral converges at infinity because the exponent exceeds 1.
